subject: RETRY phrase
notes: cite.py --check 14.7.9.2 OK (General format: RETRY { arithmetic-expression-1 TIMES | FOR arithmetic-expression-2 SECONDS | FOREVER }). kb/Work PB1162 re-verdicted (wave 73 group A): the finding was the '(' right after RETRY opening SUBSCRIPT mode, so RETRY (N) TIMES was COBOL0001. kb/Work PB1465 (56098c443) made the subscript trigger ask the compile's own reservation (a word ReservedWordSet refuses as a user word never triggers), and RETRY is reserved from 2014, so the '(' now groups. Re-probed on the w73a build: READ F RETRY (N) TIMES, WRITE R RETRY (N + 1) TIMES and OPEN INPUT RETRY (N) TIMES F compile at 2014 and 2023. Golden: WRITE R RETRY (N + 1) TIMES then READ F RETRY (N) TIMES on a relative file -> W 00, R 00 REC1 (14.7.9.3 GR4 acts only after a conflict).
